|lore=Corrupt captain in the Cloud City Wing Guard. Began working during the administration of Baron Raynor. Easily bribed. Keeps the peace through intimidation.
|game_text=Deploys only on Cloud City, but may move elsewhere. Power +2 when participating in a battle you initiate. Opponent may use 2 Force to 'bribe' Blendin to not participate in a battle.
|joke=His "easily bribed" lore is also a game rule: the opponent can pay 2 Force to "bribe" him out of a battle. [[Trooper Utris M'toc]], from the same set, "never accepts a bribe". See [[Jokes#Trooper Jerrol Blendin|Jokes]].
